description: Hidden hall program for the shared vocal reverb. Wet-only at unity; feeds live in vocal-main/vocal-back.
name: vocal-hall
notes: Precondition: FX track Hall with reverb insert slot 0 (one-time setup in Cubase). Select Hall before sending.
Feeds are separate: vocal-main sets Vocal slot 0 to 0.2, vocal-back sets Chorus slot 0 to 0.3.
Response param field shows resolved titles; on Parameter not found, shorten spelling.
Plugin mismatch names the actual insert plugin; adjust the plugin field and resend.
